swap_submitted.meaning: user has submitted a swap transaction to the Router contract
swap_submitted.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

user_deadline_specifiable.meaning: Router/Core allow the user to specify a deadline for the swap transaction
user_deadline_specifiable.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

slippage_protection_present.meaning: Router provides slippage protection via calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, protecting only against price movement relative to execution time
slippage_protection_present.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

trade_unwanted.meaning: the user experiences an unwanted trade (swap executed when the user would not have wanted it executed)
trade_unwanted.checkpoint: after execution of the submitted swap

assumptions: The swap transaction is executed by a validator or mempool holder after an extended delay, as described in the scenario.
Slippage limits (calculatedAmountThreshold, sqrtRatioLimit) do not constrain execution time, only price relative to execution time.

unresolved.description: Report does not define a concrete user-specified deadline value or time bound; the deadline mechanism is described only qualitatively.
Report describes the delayed execution and unfavorable market change conditionally; no observed delayed transaction is stated.

limitations: The deadline requirement is formalized qualitatively as absence of a user-specifiable deadline; no numeric deadline constant is given in the report.
The unwanted-trade impact is represented as a Boolean outcome because the report provides no amounts or concrete market-condition values.
The scenario is conditional; the plan does not assert that a delayed execution actually occurred.
